source: Activity templates for kana lessons. The seeder creates one activity per template for every lesson, in this order (recognize → recall → write). Placeholders: {script}, {characters}, {lesson}, {count}.

en.title: Recognize {script} {characters}
en.objective: Recognize the {script} characters {characters} and match each one to its correct sound.
en.instruction: Select the sound that matches the character.
en.explanation: Recognition is the first step: you learn to tell the characters apart before you have to recall them on your own.

id.title: Kenali {script} {characters}
id.objective: Mengenali karakter {script} {characters} dan mencocokkan masing-masing dengan bunyi yang tepat.
id.instruction: Pilih bunyi yang sesuai dengan karakter.
id.explanation: Mengenali adalah langkah pertama: Anda belajar membedakan karakter sebelum harus mengingatnya sendiri.

en.title: Read {script} {characters} from memory
en.objective: Recall the sound of each character in {characters} on sight, without answer choices.
en.instruction: Type the sound of the character in romaji.
en.explanation: Recalling without choices is harder than recognizing, and that effort is what makes the memory last.

id.title: Baca {script} {characters} dari ingatan
id.objective: Mengingat bunyi setiap karakter {characters} hanya dengan melihatnya, tanpa pilihan jawaban.
id.explanation: Mengingat tanpa pilihan lebih sulit daripada mengenali, dan usaha itulah yang membuat ingatan bertahan lama.

en.title: Write {script} {characters}
en.objective: Write {characters} from memory with the correct shape and number of strokes, without relying on a visual reference.
en.instruction: Write the character for the sound shown, in the writing area.
en.explanation: Writing by hand is production: you rebuild the character from memory, which strengthens both reading and writing. The guide fades as your writing improves.

id.title: Menulis {script} {characters}
id.objective: Menulis {characters} dari ingatan dengan bentuk dan jumlah goresan yang benar, tanpa bergantung pada contoh visual.
id.instruction: Tulis karakter untuk bunyi yang ditampilkan pada area menulis.
id.explanation: Menulis dengan tangan adalah produksi: Anda menyusun ulang karakter dari ingatan, yang memperkuat kemampuan membaca dan menulis. Panduan akan memudar seiring tulisan Anda membaik.
